description: Global health endpoint. Returns the status of all registered health checks, including the Azure AI Foundry connectivity check. Useful for monitoring dashboards and load-balancer health probes.

additionalEndpoints.liveness: GET /health/live  — Returns 200 if the process is running (no external checks).
additionalEndpoints.readiness: GET /health/ready — Returns 200 only if all 'ready'-tagged checks pass (e.g., Foundry connectivity).

checks.name: ai-foundry
checks.description: Azure AI Foundry project endpoint is reachable.
